payload.text: I order goods in which I have ordered 5 kg * 2 sugar packets with some other stuff . society have 3 lifts but rider said paper bag given by blinkit is worn out so kindly come down . pooor service by Muzaffarnagar blinkit. store gave him small paper bag for 10 kg sugar and other stuff amounting more than 1200 rupees . My father who is senior citizen had to pick the order from parking of society where blinkit boy was there . Everyone must order amount of Rs. 100/- maximum above not from blinkit
